text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...It's already this late. Considering my 
fatigue, I should head to sleep, but...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Before our next dinner meeting, I should 
read a bit more of this person's book...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Let's have some coffee. With some milk 
added so it's easy on the stomach.

And so, Daiichi Ruby ended up continuing 
to stay up late...
